newsitem.title: UK: Move out of March dominates UK grain future trade.
newsitem.headline: Move out of March dominates UK grain future trade.

text.p: March/May switches as players squared their books ahead of first day tenders on March on Monday dominated LIFFE wheat futures trading.
"That's all it was," one trader said.
Of a total 427 lots traded, 130 were on March and 161 on May, as holders switched out to avoid the tender procedure.
Futures firmed slightly. March last traded 0.15 stg up at 93.85 stg. May last traded 0.30 stg up at 97.00 stg.

During the tendering period, which draws the March contract to a close, short holders can tender to supply physical grain at a store in the UK, a LIFFE source explained. The clearing house matches that grain to long holders.
